'''Makall''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] that worked as a guard at [[The Lucky Twi'lek]] on [[Kestavel]].

==Biography==
Makall was on duty when [[Dass Jennir]], [[Beyghor Sahdett]], and the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' arrived at the casino in search of Makall's boss, [[Kai Hudorra]]. When Sahdett [[Duel on Kestavel|betrayed]] Hudorra and Jennir, Makall and fellow guard [[Urtsk]] rushed to attack the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] with their [[Vibro-ax/Legends|vibro-axes]]. The pair were no match for the former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], however, and the [[Verpine/Legends|Verpine]] killed them both by [[Sai tok/Legends|bisecting]] them with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
